The 2025 Roma Garden Open was a professional tennis tournament played on clay courts. It was the 17th edition of the tournament which was part of the 2025 ATP Challenger Tour. It took place in Rome, Italy between 21 and 27 April 2025.

Other entrants

The following players received wildcards into the singles main draw:

  • Lorenzo Carboni
  • Gabriele Pennaforti
  • Jacopo Vasamì

The following players received entry into the singles main draw as alternates:

  • Rémy Bertola
  • Francesco Maestrelli
  • Mili Poljičak

The following players received entry from the qualifying draw:

  • Mika Brunold
  • Kimmer Coppejans
  • Sandro Kopp
  • Lukáš Pokorný
  • Oleg Prihodko
  • Stefano Travaglia

Champions

Singles

Main article: 2025 Garden Open – Singles
  • Matteo Gigante def. Vilius Gaubas 6–2, 3–6, 6–4.

Doubles

Main article: 2025 Garden Open – Doubles
  • Erik Grevelius / Adam Heinonen def. Marco Bortolotti / Giorgio Ricca 7–6(7–2), 7–5.
